appraisal_events.evidence: on lui dit que c'était l'andante de la sonate pour piano et violon de Vinteuil
appraisal_events.explanation: The passage reveals, at the moment of Swann's near-transcendent rediscovery of the phrase, that it is authored by Vinteuil, associating the composer with an experience the narrator has just presented as revitalizing and precious to Swann.

status_effects.explanation: Being named as the composer of the phrase that so moved Swann casts Vinteuil in a mildly positive light by association, though he remains an offstage, unelaborated figure.
